title: CM-MAE: A Physics-Guided Cross-Modal Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Vision-Wireless Applications
abstract: arXiv:2608.15972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synchronized camera and wireless measurements observe the same scene through different physical channels. The central difficulty is that a representation learned in one deployment can fail when viewpoint, traffic, illumination, and propagation geometry change. This paper presents CM-MAE, a self-supervised vision--wireless pretraining framework for cross-scenario representation transfer. The evaluated real-data model uses only RGB frames and the measured 64-beam received-power vector available in DeepSense 6G; it does not use ray-traced paths, calibrated depth, or beam-index labels during pretraining. Its central pretraining term is a \emph{soft contrastive alignment loss}. Instead of making the synchronized image--wireless pair the only positive pair, this loss builds a target distribution from similarities between measured beam-power profiles, so nonidentical samples with similar directional responses are not forced apart as false neg

translated_title: CM-MAE：一种面向视觉-无线应用的物理引导跨模态自监督学习框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15972v1 公告类型：跨领域 摘要：同步摄像头和无线测量通过不同的物理通道观察同一场景。核心难点在于，一种部署中学习的表示在视点、交通、光照和传播几何发生变化时可能失效。本文提出CM-MAE，一种用于跨场景表示迁移的自监督视觉-无线预训练框架。评估的真实数据模型仅使用DeepSense 6G中可用的RGB帧和测量的64波束接收功率向量；在预训练期间不使用射线追踪路径、校准深度或波束索引标签。其核心预训练项是“软对比对齐损失”。该损失不是将同步图像-无线对作为唯一正样本对，而是根据测量的波束功率分布之间的相似性构建目标分布，从而使具有相似方向响应的非相同样本不会被强制分离为假负样本。
tldr: 本文提出CM-MAE框架，通过软对比对齐损失利用波束功率相似性构建目标分布，实现视觉-无线跨模态表示的跨场景迁移，避免假负样本问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents CM-MAE, a framework that uses a soft contrastive alignment loss to build target distributions from beam-power similarities, enabling cross-scenario transfer of vision-wireless representations while avoiding false negatives.
